content:
Post 1
📉 Tech crushed the ASX into the red Wednesday. The S&P/ASX 200 fell 36.80pts or 0.40% to 9,127.80, slipping below its 20-day MA. IT dropped 3.47% — the session's anchor. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔴 IT off 3.47%, Energy -1.52%, Telcos -1.38%. Consumer Staples the lone bright spot, up 1.83%. Classic risk-off rotation — defensives bid, growth sold. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 3
LOV surged 12.74% to AUD27.62 — Lovisa the standout in a sea of red. Meanwhile WOR collapsed 10.81% to AUD9.90. Two earnings stories, two very different verdicts. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD6,468.18/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7171. Gold miners felt it — Pantoro +9.96%, Perseus +9.46%. Metal strength was the session's clearest offset to the tech rout. #gold #mining #ASX

Post 5
Watch IT sector stability Thursday. WiseTech fell 10.07% to AUD40.89 — does it find a floor or drag the index further from its 52-week high? Where do you see support? #ASX #ausbiz
